page: The Microsoft Azure M416-208ms_v2 is a highly specialized, memory-optimized server belonging to the MSv2 family. It is powered by Intel Xeon 8280L processors with an x86_64 architecture, offering 104 physical cores and 208 vCPUs running at a base speed of 2.7 GHz. The server is equipped with a massive 11400.0 GB of RAM, providing an exceptional 54.81 GB of memory per core, alongside 8389 GB of local storage. This virtualized environment operates under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

Performance benchmarks reveal a distinct contrast between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core metrics, including stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores, fall into the bottom 25%, indicating limited single-threaded performance. Conversely, multi-core CPU performance and memory bandwidth are exceptional, ranking in the top 10%. Large-block read-only memory bandwidth reaches 581.2 GB/sec, and write bandwidth reaches 305.41 GB/sec, facilitating rapid data transfer across the massive memory pool.

Given its hardware profile, this server is highly cost-efficient for workloads requiring extreme memory density rather than raw single-threaded speed. It is optimized for enterprise-grade in-memory databases, large-scale Redis deployments, and heavy parallel data processing. The server's ability to handle 159.37 million Redis SET operations per second highlights its suitability for high-throughput, memory-intensive database applications.
